answer: Each identity files one copper crate with a locked bond of 70 credits. A jetty registrar keeps the public registry and rejects any duplicate filing at once. Each crate carries a crystal assay signature that must be unique, and a forged assay voids the bond. A filing costs 28 credits, rising 5 per extra identity, so the 1,000th costs 5,023 and 1,000 fakes spend 2,525,500 against a 40,000 reward pool. An honest agent files once for 28.
